table.title: Anglo-Chinese Calendar, 1928
table.caption_extra: Section: Anglo-Chinese Calendar. Seventeenth Year of the Republic. 1928.
transcriber_notes: Printed sideways (landscape) over two pages: January–June on p. 1118 (headed 'Seventeenth Year of the Republic 1928'), July–December on p. 1119 (headed '1928.—(Continued)'). Read from rotated crops.

Each month has three printed columns: day of week, date, and day of the Chinese moon; the moon numeral (e.g. 'II', 'VII') or 'INY'/'Int'c' is printed between date and moon-day on the row where it falls, recorded here in the 'Moon' column.
Rows of dashes printed below the last date of shorter months are kept as '—' rows (empty Moon column).

January 1928: 'INY' printed beside 23 (moon day 1). March 1928: 'II' printed beside 21 (moon day 30) and 'Int'c' beside 22 (moon day 1), as printed; the month headings May 'IV—IV Int'c' and June 'IV Int'c—V' are also as printed.

Unreadable (damaged type) — left blank: Jan 13 day-of-week; Feb 18 moon day (reads ':8', first digit broken); Jul 13 day-of-week; Jul 28 date (reads "'8"); Aug 20 date (second digit broken); Aug 26 moon day (reads "1'"); Sep 18 date (second digit broken); Oct 20 day-of-week (broken); Oct 23 moon day (second digit broken). The date and weekday sequences would imply Jan 13 F, Feb 18 moon 28, Jul 13 F, Jul 28 28, Aug 20 20, Aug 26 moon 12, Sep 18 18, Oct 20 S, Oct 23 moon 11 — not filled.
Damaged but legible: Jan 14 'S', Jul 12 'Th', Jul 14 'S', Mar 29 date '29', Dec 9 'Sun' (u broken), Apr 30 dash row (dash printed as '~').
